findings.observation: Reviewed Sheet 13 (Overall Site & Paving & Striping Plan) using vision tool analysis. The sheet clearly shows a comprehensive land use map with adjacent properties labeled with their zoning designations. Adjacent properties are labeled with specific zoning types including: North - CS, P (Government Services, Apartments/Condos, Office); East - CS-V (Commercial); South - CS, MU-V-CO (Apartments/Condos); West - SF-3 (Office/Single Family). Each property boundary includes both zoning designation and current use labels.
findings.reasoning: The checklist item requires a land use map showing adjacent land uses when the site is subject to Compatibility Standards. The CC Application Section 10 confirms the site is subject to Compatibility Standards (checkbox marked 'Yes'). Sheet 13 provides a comprehensive site plan that labels all adjacent properties with their zoning designations and current uses, satisfying the requirement for a land use map showing adjacent land uses. The map clearly identifies the SF-3 zoned property to the west which triggers compatibility requirements, as well as all other surrounding uses.
findings.explanation: Land use map showing adjacent zoning and uses provided on Sheet 13, including all surrounding properties with zoning labels (CS, CS-V, SF-3, MU-V-CO, P).

findings.observation: Reviewed Sheets 35-36 (North & East Overall Elevation, South & West Overall Elevation) using vision tool analysis. Sheet 35 displays building elevations for the North and East facades with comprehensive architectural elements including: Material Legend identifying 5 finish types (Fiber Cement Board Painted, King Brick, Wood Tone Fiber Cement, Glass, Living Wall); detailed fenestration patterns showing windows and glazing; balconies with railings; material changes across the facade; floor level markers for all 6 levels plus roof with elevation heights; special features including a living wall on the ground floor. Sheet 36 similarly shows South and West elevations with the same level of architectural detail and material legend.
findings.reasoning: The checklist item requires building elevations showing architectural elements when subject to Compatibility Standards. Sheets 35 and 36 provide all four building elevations (North, East, South, West) with extensive architectural detail including material legends, fenestration patterns, balconies, floor levels with heights, material transitions, and special features. This exceeds the minimum requirement for building elevations showing architectural elements, providing a comprehensive representation of the building's exterior design that would allow compatibility review.
findings.explanation: Building elevations for all four facades provided on Sheets 35-36, showing architectural elements including material legend, windows, balconies, floor levels, and material transitions.

findings.observation: Reviewed Sheet 14 (Dimensional Control & Site Plan 1 of 2) using vision tool analysis and blocks.md. The sheet contains a 'COMPATIBILITY SETBACK LINES' table specifying setback requirements with distance ranges (0'-10', 10'-25' Screening Zone at 0' height, 25'-50' Restricted Zone at 0' height, 50'-75' at 40' height, and 60' height for greater distances). The site plan graphically depicts compatibility setback lines adjacent to the SF-3 zoned property on the west, with specific labels for 15', 25', 50', and 75' compatibility setback lines shown as dashed lines stepping back from the property line. An additional notation shows '75' Building Setback Per Rezone' adjacent to residential zoning.
findings.reasoning: The checklist item requires setbacks adjacent to residential uses or zoning to be shown on plans when subject to Compatibility Standards. Sheet 14 provides both tabular and graphical representation of compatibility setbacks. The table specifies the graduated height limits based on distance from the property line (the compatibility setback standard under LDC Article 10), and the site plan shows these setback lines graphically adjacent to the SF-3 triggering property. This dual representation (table + graphic) satisfies the requirement to show setbacks adjacent to residential uses/zoning on the plans.
findings.explanation: Compatibility setbacks shown on Sheet 14 with both a table specifying distance/height requirements and graphical setback lines (15', 25', 50', 75') adjacent to SF-3 residential zoning.

summary: All 3 items pass. Land use map showing adjacent zoning provided on Sheet 13; building elevations with architectural elements provided on Sheets 35-36; compatibility setbacks adjacent to residential uses shown on Sheet 14.
